title: be 动词 · Verb be (am/is/are)
summary: 对应：7A 问候与自我介绍
explanation:
【结构】I am / You are / He is / She is / It is / We are / They are
【用法】表身份、状态、位置。
【例句】I am fine. / She is a student.
【易错】✗ He are → ✓ He is

title: 指示代词 this/that · Demonstratives
explanation:
【结构】This is ... / That is ...
【用法】this 近处，that 远处。
【例句】This is a ruler. / What's that in English?

title: What color · 颜色问句
explanation:
【结构】What color is it? — It's + 颜色.
【例句】What color is your bag? — It's blue.

title: 名词所有格 · Possessive 's
explanation:
【结构】名词 + 's + 名词
【例句】This is my sister's book.
【易错】✗ my sister book → ✓ my sister's book

title: 一般疑问句 Is this...? · Yes/No Questions
explanation:
【结构】Beach/Are + 主语 + 名词?
【回答】Yes, it is. / No, it isn't.
【例句】Is this your pencil?

title: Where 问句与介词 · Where + prepositions
explanation:
【结构】Where is ...? — It's on/in/under...
【例句】Where's my schoolbag? — It's on the chair.

title: Do you have...? · Have questions
explanation:
【结构】Do you have + 名词?
【回答】Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
【例句】Do you have a soccer ball?

title: Do you like + countable nouns
explanation:
【结构】Do you like + 复数/不可数?
【例句】Do you like bananas? — Yes, I do.

title: How much 与价格 · How much
explanation:
【结构】How much is/are ...?
【例句】How much are these socks? — They're five dollars.

title: When 与序数词 · When + ordinals
explanation:
【结构】When is your birthday? — It's on + 日期.
【例句】My birthday is on May 2nd.

title: Why 与 because · Why/because
explanation:
【结构】Why do you like ...? — Because ...
【例句】Why do you like science? — Because it's interesting.

title: can 表能力 · Modal can
explanation:
【结构】Can + 主语 + 动词原形?
【例句】Can you play the guitar? — Yes, I can.

title: What time · 时刻表达
explanation:
【结构】What time do you ...? — I ... at + 时刻.
【例句】What time do you go to school? — At seven o'clock.

title: How 问交通方式 · How + transport
explanation:
【结构】How do you get to ...? — By bus/bike/on foot.
【例句】How do you get to school? — I take the bus.

title: 祈使句与 don't · Imperatives
explanation:
【结构】动词原形开头 / Don't + 动词原形
【例句】Don't eat in class. / Be quiet, please.

title: There be 句型 · There is/are
explanation:
【结构】There is + 单数 / There are + 复数
【例句】Is there a post office near here? — Yes, there is.

title: What does he look like? · Appearance
explanation:
【结构】What does ... look like? — He/She is tall/has...
【例句】What does he look like? — He is of medium height.

title: would like 点餐 · Would like
explanation:
【结构】I'd like + 名词 / Would you like ...?
【例句】I'd like some noodles, please.

title: 一般现在时被动 · Present Passive
explanation:
【结构】am/is/are + 过去分词
【例句】English is spoken in many countries.

title: used to 与感叹句 · used to / exclamations
explanation:
【结构】used to + 动词原形 / What + (a/an) + adj + n!
【例句】I used to be shy. / What a beautiful day!

title: 过去完成时 · Past Perfect
explanation:
【结构】had + 过去分词
【用法】过去的过去。
【例句】When I got home, he had already left.

title: 情态动词表推测 · Modals for deduction
explanation:
【结构】must / can't / might + 动词原形
【例句】He must be at home. / It can't be true.

title: 中考语法综合 · Review mix
explanation: 综合复习：时态、从句、被动、情況等中考高频考点。
